note: index_name/sets as before. "top_10" was renamed "top_5" to match the candidate-pool UI. UPDATE 2026-08-14: the index is now COMPLETE. All 69 sets carry real, JustTCG-verified Near Mint prices. The true top 50 has been computed by taking every shortlisted (top-3-per-set) card from gold-eligible sets (release date more than 90 days before compute date 2026-08-14 -- the eligibility window was intentionally raised from an earlier 30-day threshold to 90 days, since new-set price volatility made 30 days too short a track record to trust), ranking all of those candidates by Near Mint price descending, and marking exactly the top 50 in_index: true. No set contributed more than 3 cards to the final 50 (max observed: 3, matching the per-set shortlist cap) -- verified programmatically, not assumed. The "index composition is still finalizing" language is removed as no longer accurate; this note will need a fresh update whenever the index is recomputed (e.g. once Chaos Rising or Pitch Black age into eligibility, or if new sets are added).
